title: PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V4 dependence-aware robustness on current live main
summary: PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V4 adds episode-aware effective sample size, Newey-West/HAC dependence-adjusted inference, BH-FDR over the same dependence-adjusted p-values, and cross-revision contradiction/transportability diagnostics while preserving V3 temporal and parameter-basin robustness. Current-main audit found and repaired two real defects before merge: BH q-values still used naive p-values under HAC, and parameter-basin diagnostics leaked the last processed remainder signature across independent parameter families. Both paths are regression-locked. DREAMSTATE carries the corrected evidence into policy contracts, Brain mirrors, search accounting, refresh, and live source revalidation. All authority remains research/shadow only.
